entries.text: Aaj office mein boss ne sabke saamne daanta. Kaam ka pressure bahut hai, deadline kal hai.
Neend nahi aati yaar, raat ko 3am tak jaagta rehta hoon. Subah exhausted feel hota hai.
Weekend pe bhi laptop khol ke baitha tha. Wife se fight ho gayi kyunki main ghar pe time nahi deta.
Drinking a bit more these days just to sleep. Kuch accha nahi lagta, no interest in anything.
Salary late hai is month, EMI ka tension alag se. I'm so irritable, I snapped at my kid.
Breathing exercise try kiya but it didn't help today. Mann bahut bhaari hai.
Kabhi kabhi lagta hai marna hi better hai, sab ke liye bojh ban gaya hoon.
